admission_and_stop_conditions: Freeze source manifests, checksum sidecars, normalized schemas, a matched Binance spot and USD-M perpetual accounting ledger, capital allocation, margin rules, funding cash-flow sign, costs, windows and all-pass gates before opening any strategy outcome.

Use only official Binance public archives with observations no later than 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z. Verify every ZIP against its CHECKSUM sidecar, reject gaps or conflicting timestamps and seal raw plus normalized hashes.

The strategy mechanism must be delta-neutral long BTC spot and short equal BTC perpetual notional; funding is credited to the short only when the official funding rate is positive and debited when negative. Mark-to-market basis, spot/perpetual trading costs, collateral use and liquidation buffer cannot be omitted.

Require positive normal and stressed net carry, bounded drawdown and basis path, annual breadth, no liquidation, no terminal-basis uplift and superiority to zero-yield cash after opportunity cost; otherwise close the exact frozen policy.

Any ambiguity in funding timestamp, sign, spot/perpetual price identity, contract units, mark price, margin, liquidation, rebalance or fee accounting returns evidence insufficient before outcome access.
A positive historical result may create at most one REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED candidate and one independent sealed OOS gate; it authorizes no Trading action.
causal_hypothesis: For a USD-M perpetual contract, positive funding transfers value from long holders to short holders. Holding matched BTC spot against an equal-BTC perpetual short can remove most first-order BTC direction while harvesting the funding transfer, but only if basis changes, trading friction, collateral drag and liquidation risk do not consume the carry.
claim_boundary: This prior makes one official-archive, delta-neutral Binance BTCUSDT spot-plus-perpetual funding-carry family source-ready only. It supports a cash-flow mechanism and a free pre-2025 data path, not profitability, a completed ledger, a hypothesis, a candidate, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority.
economic_hypothesis: A fully specified long-spot short-perpetual BTCUSDT carry book may earn positive fee-, slippage-, basis- and funding-adjusted returns with materially lower drawdown than directional BTC, broad annual support and no liquidation under adverse funding and basis stress.

independence_assessment.not_closed_carry_veto: The closed DRA crypto-carry family attempted to use a carry level to admit or veto directional DRA entries. This family earns the actual funding cash flow in a matched long-spot short-perpetual book and is evaluated against cash, not as a BTC timing overlay.
independence_assessment.not_directional_btc_timing: Spot and perpetual BTC delta are matched rather than switched between long and cash; return is attributed to funding, basis convergence, fees and residual hedge error.
independence_assessment.not_funding_signal_scan: The next gate must freeze one accounting policy before performance access. It cannot optimize funding thresholds, timing or leverage from outcomes.
independence_assessment.residual_risk: Cross-leg execution, perpetual basis, funding sign reversals, exchange margin and liquidation can make nominal funding yield unprofitable or unsafe. A simplified ledger that ignores any of these is not acceptable evidence.

missing_proof: The full 2020-2024 funding, Binance spot and perpetual price archives are not checksum-verified, normalized or sealed.
No frozen capital, collateral, notional, rebalance, margin, liquidation, fee, slippage, funding timestamp or basis ledger exists.
No schema-valid hypothesis, manifest, deterministic runner, matched cash comparator, Design or Validation economics, annual breadth, candidate, OOS or forward evidence exists.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The BIS crypto-carry study describes cash-and-carry as buying crypto spot and selling futures, and uses funding rates, futures basis, option-implied volatility and realized volatility to study crypto carry and its risks.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Aquilina, Frost and Schrimpf, Crypto carry, BIS Working Papers No 1087
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The paper supports the carry mechanism and risk relevance, not this exact Binance perpetual ledger, holding policy or net return.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: Binance publishes public monthly BTCUSDT USD-M funding-rate archives beginning in 2020 and documents the funding-rate history interface without requiring a private trading account for the public archive.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Binance public data and USD-M market-data documentation
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Source availability does not establish complete matched spot/perpetual price coverage, correct accounting or profitability.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: Existing Agora source audit excluded funding-level carry as a directional DRA veto, but that closure did not test or account for realized funding cash flows in a delta-neutral spot-perpetual book.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Agora Binance USD-M source capability and closed carry-veto fingerprint
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The new family must remain delta-neutral and cash-flow based. It cannot reinterpret the closed DRA carry-veto signal or use a different venue to revive it.
